events.ranking_rationale: The fading giant supports two precise responses, while Bell and a strengthened cheap character directly reinforce void materialization.

events.prose: You watch an immense horse and rider dissolve against the star-filled sky.

actions.label: Follow the Changing Figure
actions.resolution: Its scattered outline settles into unfamiliar forms.
actions.template: The next draft or shop site you visit will contain transfigured cards
actions.effect_text: The next draft or shop site you visit will contain transfigured cards

actions.label: Take the High Saddle
actions.resolution: A traveler ascends with the horseman's martial bearing.
actions.template: Change a chosen Character card to have {subtype}
actions.effect_text: Change a chosen Character card to have Warrior

events.ranking_rationale: Visible dissolution grounds the altered offers, and taking the saddle creates another warrior trigger for the source strategy.

events.prose: Before you, a towering horseman emerges beyond the overgrown limb.

actions.label: Call the Mounted Host
actions.resolution: More silhouettes emerge through the luminous haze.
actions.template: Take any number of {predicate} cards from 4 random choices
actions.effect_text: Take any number of Warrior cards from 4 random choices

actions.label: Clear the Overgrown Limb
actions.resolution: Loose moss falls away, exposing clean bark.
actions.template: Add a purge site to this dreamscape.
actions.effect_text: Add a purge site to this dreamscape.

events.ranking_rationale: The mounted silhouette and mossy limb support both actions cleanly, with warrior selection providing the stronger strategic connection.

events.prose: Above you, an immense horse dissolves into drifting points of light.

actions.label: Call for Its Double
actions.resolution: A second silhouette forms beside the fading horse.
actions.template: Add a duplication site to this dreamscape
actions.effect_text: Add a duplication site to this dreamscape

actions.label: Gather the Drifting Motes
actions.resolution: Bright specks collect among the moss-covered roots.
actions.template: Gain a random amount of essence between {essence1} and {essence2}
actions.effect_text: Gain a random amount of essence between 200 and 300

events.ranking_rationale: The dissolving horse makes doubling and gathering immediate, though both rewards offer broad value rather than focused source synergy.

events.prose: A moss-covered limb stretches beneath you toward the colossal horseman.

actions.label: Search Beneath the Moss
actions.resolution: A brown acorn drops free with clinging roots.
actions.template: Gain {count} "Nightmare" bane cards. Gain {dreamsign}.
actions.effect_text: Gain 2 "Nightmare" bane cards. Gain Brown Acorn.

actions.label: Share the Horseman's Bearing
actions.resolution: Every companion assumes the same imposing posture.
actions.template: All characters in your deck become the subtype of your choice.
actions.effect_text: All characters in your deck become the subtype of your choice.

events.ranking_rationale: The branch grounds the warrior-supporting acorn and shared bearing, but the Nightmare burden has the set's least direct visual bridge.
